meta.caption: Source: EMODnet Bathymetry high-resolution patch 590_HR_Lidar_Centro, DGT/APA airborne lidar survey, 2011. Licence CC BY 4.0 (as reported by EMODnet; the patch record itself does not restate it). Not for navigation. Grid cells about 11 x 14 m; depths relative to LAT (Lowest Astronomical Tide, as stated by EMODnet). The data stops about 500-600 m offshore at roughly 8-11 m depth: nothing is known beyond that, and gaps are left empty, not filled. All cells with data are shown (no thinning).
